body.p: There is a tent on the river bank. It is not made of real poles. This tent is made of grass. There live two men. They have no father, no mother. They live there many years. They have no clothes, they are without clothes. They get fish well from the river. One man says to his mate: "This life is bad. We have to look for a good life. People say that there's a good life exists." "Where will we go?" "You go on the left side of the river, and I'll go on the right. Your name will be 'left side', my name will be 'right side'.
